name: Inamori Alice
source:
Side character of episode 1
[url=/c92638]Aruru[/url]'s mother.
A woman who is famous for being the youngest person to win the Shirakawa family's inheritance competition and bring together the sisters. Also, the only person who was able to keep the "Child of God", which remains trouble for both government and the sect, under control. Because of her increasing workload, she decides to leave [url=/c92638]Aruru[/url] under [url=/c92641]Subaru[/url]'s care.
